concept.hr: Lažirani mali upiti postaju velik odgovor kod žrtve
concept.en: Spoofed small requests become a large reply at the victim

summary.hr: Napadač šalje male lažirane upite javnim UDP uslugama; one odgovaraju žrtvi, uvećano faktorom pojačanja. Biraj uslugu, brzinu, kapacitet i obrane.
summary.en: An attacker sends small forged requests to public UDP services; they reply to the victim, amplified by the factor. Pick service, rate, capacity, defences.
